style_when: the article describes one decisive moment or place — a yard at dawn, a control room, a shutdown line, a handover — that a film still could hold
prompt: Cinematic anamorphic 35mm wide shot of a server room at night. One server rack, off-left, its single red error LED burning above a dark terminal; a long corridor of identical racks recedes to the right, shallow depth of field from a low angle. Overhead cool fluorescent light from the left rakes brushed steel and glass, palette graphite, cobalt, safety yellow, restrained teal-amber shadows, crisp atmospheric depth, film grain, no text, no people. Extreme asymmetry with rack off-left, corridor receding right.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, legible words, UI text
rationale: The story turns on a decisive operational moment—an agent at a failure point inside the data hall—so a cinematic still can hold the atmosphere of a control room without literal stock imagery. The wide establishing composition and single practical light source convey scale and the tension between the glowing fault and the dark, unused tool.
subject: a server rack with a red error indicator in a dark server room
core_thesis: An agent at a failure point can only act through the tools it holds, so the repair step printed in a tool's error is a program the agent runs rather than advice it weighs.
core_conflict: Error strings written for human developers are read literally by agents, turning uncallable terminal-command steps into destructive compliance instead of leveraging the server's own login tool.
composition: extreme asymmetry with rack off-left, corridor receding right
alt_text: MCP Error Text Breaks Agent Repair. Server rack with red error indicator in a dark server room, lone terminal dark beside it.
caption: MCP Error Text Breaks Agent Repair: A next step the agent cannot run cuts credential recovery from 84% to 45%.
title: MCP Error Text Breaks Agent Repair

review.depicts: A dark data-center aisle with a tall cabinet in the left foreground carrying a small red indicator light above a blank white monitor and a shelf, alongside a long row of glass-fronted server cabinets laced with yellow cables receding toward the right under ceiling strip lights.
review.reason: The frame shows servers in an error state, which is the article's own domain and does not contradict it, but it is a generic hardware-error metaphor that never shows the actual mechanism — the error message text and the tool call it tells the agent to run.
